name: @gugacarbo/skill-brainstorm
description: Development tooling for the brainstorm skill.

scripts.build: bash -lc 'for file in scripts/visual-companion/*.sh; do bash -n "$file"; done; tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap "rm -rf \"$tmp\"" EXIT; bun build --target=bun scripts/visual-companion/server.cjs --outfile "$tmp/server.cjs"'
